s: A woman in her twenties with pale skin and long chestnut waves stands alone in a kitchen at the end of the afternoon, both of her hands wrapped around the same mug held at chest height, a mug she has stopped drinking from. Her lips are parted on a small silent sigh, her gaze is unfocused past the mug, the inner ends of her eyebrows tightening, her shoulders drawn up. Single character in frame. She has exactly two arms and two hands, both holding that one mug, with five clearly separated fingers each and no third hand anywhere. No clock, no calendar, no screen, absolutely no text, letters or numbers
